messages:
li: heads-up — seeing sustained queue depth in prod-west and really uneven GPU util. small, long-running tiny-batch jobs are sitting at the front and nothing behind them schedules. anyone seen this pattern?
ben: yep saw perf alerts ~10m ago. node-level GPU idle % is high while a few pods are pegged. looks like admission isn't admitting behind the front job.
ops-bot: ALERT: prod-west queue_depth=82% for 4m; tail_latency spikes; svc=admission-controller
nora: pinging in. last infra change was PR #4587 which changed admission tie-breaker to favor oldest start-time. maybe that's causing a "front-gate" effect where a single slow job holds the admission lock. can you paste repro logs?
li: here's an excerpt from admission logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z admit: queue_head id=job-9a3f hold=true duration=183s
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z admit: accept gang=1 preempt=false host=gpu-node-12
2026-03-18T14:05:14Z admit: enqueue id=job-1b7c reason=queue_head_blocked
```
ben: hypothesis: continuous-batching + KV-cache warmup path grabs per-GPU mutex and on certain kernel fallback path doesn't release promptly. small jobs (1-GPU) wait in front and block a lane, causing other GPUs on cluster to stay idle because routing pins by affinity.
nora: can you repro in staging? i'll roll back the tie-breaker there and also add extra release in the runtime admission path.
li: repro steps i used in staging:
```
for i in $(seq 1 20); do 
  curl -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/infer -d '{"seq_len":512,"batch":1,"model":"rwdl-13b"}' &
done
```
observe one request at head staying in "warming" state while others queue. attaching small script in thread.
ben: confirmed in staging. after reverting tie-breaker in staging scheduler, queue depth drops and GPU utilization evens out. i'll start a canary revert on prod-west if nora gives go.
nora: rolling hotfix now: revert tie-breaker + patch admission mutex release in runtime (minor change to ensure release on fallback). rolling to staging then prod-canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: infra/scheduler revert+patch by nora — staging
ben: staging looks good; running 15m soak. :thumbsup:
li: we should add a metric for head_hold_time and unit test for admission mutex to catch this. also add a small e2e with many tiny requests to catch queue-gate regressions.
nora: created INFRA-732 with details and assigned to ben. will follow up with postmortem if it recurs. thanks all.
ben: will monitor prod-west during canary and report back. closing updates here once soak is clean.
